scope: Ordinary white-border Eighth Edition basic lands, exact source assets and set-hsb-v1 opt-in. Large symbols are independently colored; native glyph geometry, white highlights and neutral shadows are retained.

mask.coordinateSystem: Native source UV represented at 488x680, before the independent geometry warp. Traced blue pinline contours with 0.2 canonical-pixel simplification; material edges feather over 0.4 canonical pixel.

cohorts.policy: Four printings per color; fixed UUID cohorts chosen before fitting, two calibration and two validation per color except Swamp (two and one). This finite-inventory study does not satisfy or replace the generic three-plus-three gates used for broader old-frame transfer.

decision: Adopt the source-bound per-color materials and shared outer tone curve. Actual reserved medians improve for every material group, with individual header/paper color-distance regressions below 0.10. Combined geometry and color improves all nineteen structural scores against 0.2.26. Source texture and lettering differences remain visible.
limitations: Color-only changes can move the contrast-threshold structural metric without moving any symbol or text: worst reserved change is -0.0312 on Island 338 relative to geometry alone. Report color error separately; do not tune away a correct color to increase edge score.
Color samples exclude artwork, words and the large glyph; glyph color uses an eroded source-alpha mask. Tiny paper/header differences and scan-to-scan color variation remain.
No claim of foil, other-set or broader-artifact/land transfer. Swamp 339 remains unscored pending reliable alignment.
